sentences.text: The temperatures in several rooms stayed below 18.0 °C during the night, which the WHO recommends against in cold seasons.
The parents' room was the coldest, reaching 16.8 °C at 05:50, while the bathroom was 17.3 °C at 03:40.
The teenager's room was 17.5 °C at 05:30, and the office dipped to 17.9 °C at 05:20.
Since the office temperature was low (17.9 °C at 05:20, C4), perhaps it is time to check the heating system.
